title: Grocery List Import
description: Input shapes accepted by the 'Advanced — bulk import JSON' control in the offline grocery list HTML (see grocery-list skill). Use this schema to AI-generate or hand-author item lists for merging into the Custom section. The shopper pastes the JSON into the textarea and presses Import; the imported items behave exactly like manually-typed Custom items (persistent in localStorage, deletable, editable).

oneOf.description: Top-level array form. Each entry is either a bare ingredient string or an item object.
Wrapped object form. Equivalent to the array form but allows future top-level metadata.

text.description: Ingredient line as it should appear in the list. Verbatim — include measurements and prep notes (e.g., '1 lb. butter, softened').

checked.description: Whether the item should be pre-checked when imported. Defaults to false.
